variant.title: Position Sums Sudoku
variant.description: The first two digits select two positions; the two outside lanes show their direct sum and selected-position sum.
rule_guide.title: Position Sums Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Rows, columns, and 3x3 boxes contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: For each directed clue line, the first two digits are A and B. The first lane is A+B.
rule_guide.item_3: The second lane is the sum of the digits at positions A and B, counted from the shown side.
